Amazing! Very fine work, I must say.
A resourceful hero like you surely wants to unlock even greater potential, yes?
Some sets—if you enhance each part of the set twice—will give you a {{Color TotK|Red|special bonus}} when you wear them. Not every set, mind you! But some...|Great Fairy Tera|TotK}} are a recurring mechanic in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== Set Bonuses are a type of [[Added Effect]] that can only be obtained by wearing all three pieces of certain [[Armor Set]]s. Usually Set Bonuses will require all three pieces of the Armor Set to be enhanced at least twice by a [[Great Fairy]], but some Armor Sets have their Set Bonus by default. While Set Bonuses replace the Added Effect name that is displayed in the Inventory, they do not remove the Effects provided by the individual pieces of the Armor Set, although some Set Bonuses may effectively nullify their benefits. One example of this can be found in the [[Froggy Armor]]'s Set Bonus Slip Proof, which functions as an improved version of Slip Resistance. ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, there are 15 different Set Bonuses, two of which are hidden in the [[Inventory]]. ====Set Bonuses in {{BotW|-}}==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |sortable= false |columns= Set Bonus[Nowrap], Found On[List][Nowrap], Description[Description] | [[Ancient Proficiency]] | [[Ancient Set]] (★★), [[Vah Medoh Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★), [[Vah Naboris Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★), [[Vah Rudania Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★), [[Vah Ruta Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★) | Increases the attack power of Ancient Weapons by 80%.
